technicalNotes:
Bu arıza kodu şu modülde görüldüğünde: an Audi A6 Allroad (4B) with the Bosch 5.3 ABS/EDS/ASR/ESP system, the soft coding of the ABS may be incorrect.
Many Audi A6 Allroads do not have "Manual with Low Range (only Audi A6 Allroad)".  Try coding the ABS module as "Manual".
